final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS health_status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS scan_total, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM step1) SELECT step1.health_status, step1.scan_total, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg_ratio AS ratio_difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg_ratio
